items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: this is where at the time when I got to California that I met Art Tatum.

ctx.x: And he had that sense of time, rhythm and everything that was infallable sense of rhythm.
Yes. And the thing I think made him more popular than Art Tatum was he was louder. That's the thing that made him -- Fats Waller what he was.
